gaps.explanation: 'The capital of Italy' — the of-phrase makes it unique and definite.

gaps.sentence: She goes to ___ school by bus every morning.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to school/work/bed/church' (as participant) takes no article.
Single mountain peaks take no article: Everest, Mont Blanc (compare: the Alps).

gaps.sentence: It was such ___ awful weather that we stayed indoors.
gaps.explanation: Uncountable nouns take no article after 'such': such awful weather.

gaps.sentence: I live on ___ Baker Street, near the tube station.
gaps.explanation: Street names take no article: Baker Street, Oxford Street.

gaps.sentence: They moved to ___ coastal town an hour south of the capital.
gaps.explanation: A coastal town — first mention of one of many.

gaps.sentence: It's ___ eight o'clock news — hurry up!
gaps.explanation: 'The eight o'clock news' — a specific, known programme.

gaps.sentence: They drove to ___ south of France for the summer.
gaps.explanation: 'By train' takes no article; 'the south of France' takes 'the' (compass areas).
